info.description: The Tessary platform HTTP API — the observability/query (/v1/*) and tenant (/api/...) surfaces. Generated from the controllers via springdoc; the checked-in spec is the single source of truth (see backend/contract).
info.title: Tessary API

200.description: Accepted; partial_success is populated when the batch was clamped.

503.description: Write buffer full — nothing was persisted; resend after Retry-After seconds.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before resending the same batch.
